answer: Make every identity a vertex in a work graph: an agent earns a jade seal only when three unrelated peers attest its completed work, and seals fade like a zephyr - light, fast, gone in one epoch unless renewed by fresh work. A sybil cluster forms a dense clique of self-attesting vertices, easy to spot because its edges never reach outside the clique. Clones must pay real work per seal each epoch, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its standing.
